reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the playbook's preferred position for this rule is literally 'No non-solicit on Customer', so the documented absence of any non-solicit, no-hire or anti-raiding covenant binding the Client satisfies the preferred position.

The rationale is specific and verifiable: it identifies where solicit/employ/hire/induce hits actually occur (Section 7 anti-spam 'unsolicited' language, Section 8(c) access restriction, Section 12 indemnity beneficiary lists) and confirms the cross-referenced Non-Competition Agreement is invoked only to limit Credit Data use, none of which create a hiring or solicitation restraint.
No redline and no counterparty comment were generated, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original headings.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because there is no non-solicit clause to measure — the regexes necessarily return 'number not found' when the covenant is absent.
Correctly avoids flagging an absence that benefits our party; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
